correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md and standard-library verifier. With fixed unit A,B at central angle theta, the acute-angle inequalities are |u·C|<sin(theta/2) and v·C<cos(theta/2) for orthonormal midpoint/chord coordinates. Since the excluded cap is contained in the belt, conditional probability q(theta)=sin(theta/2)-(1-cos(theta/2))/2. Uniform A·B on [-1,1] yields E q=1/2 and E q²=(pi-1)/8. Different third points are conditionally independent given shared endpoints, hence covariance (pi-3)/8 for shared pairs. For one shared point, rotation invariance makes conditional mean exactly 1/2; otherwise independent. Unordered overlap-two pairs count C(n,2)C(n-2,2), so Var=C(n,3)/4 +(pi-3)C(n,2)C(n-2,2)/4, with n=4 variance (3pi-7)/2. Independently numerically integrated conditional q and q² obtaining 0.5000000000 and 0.2676990816 vs (pi-1)/8=0.2676990817; geometric and combinatorial proofs establish all n.
residual_risks: Uses planar angles of Euclidean chord triangles, not geodesic sphere triangle angles; right angles measure zero.
